result.summary: The page renders mostly well, but the "Fastest near you" carousel has inconsistent card alignment/sizing, and the favorite (heart) buttons in "Popular right now" are styled inconsistently.

issues.description: In the "Fastest near you" carousel the cards are not aligned on a common baseline: the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) sits noticeably lower than the first and third cards, and its image tile is taller, so titles and delivery-fee lines appear at three different vertical positions.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel items the same fixed image height and align items to the top of the row (e.g. align-items: flex-start with a uniform card height) so titles and prices line up.

issues.description: The first carousel card (Green Bowl Poké) has a pale grey background while the sibling cards use dark photo-style backgrounds, making it look like the image failed to load or is a placeholder.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent image treatment/fallback background for all carousel thumbnails, or supply the proper image asset for Green Bowl Poké.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons on the "Popular right now" cards are styled differently: the first is a plain white outline icon while the second sits inside a dark filled circle.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same button treatment (same background, size and icon color) to every favorite toggle.
